definitions.explanation: a baseball statistic counting runs scored as a result of a batter's action

examples.japanese: {今季|こんき}100{打点|だてん}を{達成|たっせい}した。
タイムリーヒットで2{打点|だてん}を{挙|あ}げた。
examples.english: He drove in 2 runs with a timely hit.

notes:
BASEBALL STATISTIC:
{打点|だてん} combines {打|だ} (hitting) + {点|てん} (points). It's the Japanese equivalent of RBI (Runs Batted In).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {打点|だてん}を{稼|かせ}ぐ/{挙|あ}げる - to drive in runs
- {打点|だてん}を{記録|きろく}する - to record an RBI
- {打点王|だてんおう} - RBI leader/champion

CONTEXTS WHERE RBIS ARE EARNED:
- ヒット - base hits
- {犠牲|ぎせい}フライ - sacrifice fly
- {押|お}し{出|だ}し{四球|しきゅう} - walk with bases loaded
- {内野|ないや}ゴロ - infield groundout (certain situations)

RELATED STATS:
- {打率|だりつ} - batting average
- {本塁打|ほんるいだ} - home run
- {安打|あんだ} - base hit
- {得点|とくてん} - runs scored
